email_subject: Application - E-Commerce Intern, Purina Category Management
email_body:
Dear Nestlé Purina Hiring Team,

I would like to apply for the E-Commerce Intern position in Purina's Category Management team in Brussels, starting January 2027.

I am a digital marketer working where SEO, content and web meet. At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, including an e-commerce client, and I build and maintain Shopify stores: store design, product catalogues, product pages and blog content. Adding and updating product content per retailer is the work I already do daily.

I also work with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, use structured data to make content findable in AI search, and build WordPress sites myself, including one for a pharmacists' association - useful context for both pharmacy and specialist retailers.

My CV is attached. I would gladly talk through how I can help grow Purina's e-content and online visibility.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Nestlé Purina Hiring Team,

I am applying for the E-Commerce Intern position in Purina's Category Management team in Brussels, starting January 2027. Your brief describes online content that has to look right, read well and perform across pureplayers, bricks and clicks, pharmacy and specialist retailers. Most of my work sits in exactly that space.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, one of them an e-commerce store, and I build and maintain Shopify shops: designing the store, adding and updating the product catalogue, writing product descriptions and blog content. For a pharmacists' association I keep a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages, which taught me how much discipline sits behind content that scales. That is the same discipline E-content needs when assortment changes and brand relaunches arrive from several retailers at once.

I bring the analytical half too. I work with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs and report on what content actually does. My own sites are my test lab: structured data, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt and AI-search visibility are all things I have implemented myself, and I use LLMs and Python to automate the repetitive parts of audits and content work - more time for judgement, less for copy-paste. That habit should translate well to rolling out new e-content tools and tracking Purina's and competitors' visibility online.

At KXP I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace projects for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo, which is where I learned how retail and category structures work from the inside - briefings, agencies and cross-team coordination included.

Practically: I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, available for the full six months from January 2027. English is fluent; my Dutch is at B1 writing and A2+ speaking and I am actively improving it.

I would welcome the chance to talk about Purina's e-content footprint and where I can contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
